agentsign.help.detail:
deckent agents signers [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Lists the scope's signer keys: purpose, bound principal, custody, state and how many catalog rows each signed.
deckent agents enrol-signer --principal <issuer:subject> --label <text> [--scope <id>]
  Generates a host-kept action key for one AI or system principal (a person's card).
deckent agents add-signer --input <file> [--scope <id>]
  Registers an external public key from the JSON file (purpose, publicKey, principal, label).
deckent agents revoke-signer <key-id> [--scope <id>]
  Revokes a key at once: its new, pending and replayed actions are refused; rows it already signed stay and are marked.
deckent agents repair-signers [--scope <id>]
  Repairs a broken revocation log; revocations are only ever added.
deckent agents import-skill --input <file> [--scope <id>]
  Imports a skill that is pinned and signed by an import key of this scope (skillId, name, text, source, pin, signature).
Every signer card and the import run only on your own terminal; AI tools, pipes and --json are refused. A private key never leaves this host's key store: not in backups, arguments, environment, logs, model prompts or workers.

error.CATALOG_SIGNER_UNKNOWN: Refused: the signing key is not registered in this scope. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_SIGNER_REVOKED: Refused: the signing key is revoked. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_SIGNER_MISMATCH: Refused: the signing key is not bound to this principal or this purpose. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_SIGNATURE_INVALID: Refused: the signature does not cover exactly this catalog action. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED: Refused: an AI or system principal changes the catalog only with its own active signing key. Nothing was changed.
error.SKILL_SIGNER_REFUSED: Refused: only a person adds or revokes signer keys, at their own terminal.
error.SKILL_SIGNER_INVALID: Refused: the signer key is invalid, or this principal already has an active action key (revoke it first). Nothing was changed.
error.SIGNER_REVOCATION_LOG_BROKEN: The signer revocation log is broken; AI and system signing is stopped. Run deckent agents repair-signers.
error.SIGNER_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: The signer key store is unavailable or the key is missing on this host; nothing was signed. After a restore or on a new host, enrol the key again.
